The Vaulten API is the single API used by the iOS app and the admin dashboard. **Conventions** (see `docs/04-api-conventions.md`) - Success bodies are wrapped: `{ "data": ..., "meta": ... }`. - Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`). **Switch on `code`**, never on `title` or `detail`. - Field names are camelCase, timestamps ISO 8601 UTC, money is `{ amountCents, currency }`. - Ignore unknown response fields and handle unknown enum values gracefully. - Send `X-Request-Id` when you have one; quote it when reporting a problem.
Error code catalog — 123 codes in 12 modules (click to expand)

Every error is RFC 9457 Problem Details; switch on code. Codes are grouped by the module that owns them; shared codes can come from any endpoint.
